CrowdStrike Co-Founder and CEO George Kurtz sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on Opening Bid for a conversation about the concerns around AI chatbot deployment and the role cybersecurity will have as more tech companies invest in building out AI data center infrastructure. Also watch George Kurtz discuss CrowdStrike's latest streak of acquisitions. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
